newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 14.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil consortium of Shell International and United Meridian Corp to invest 1.5 billion CFA francs for deep sea oil exploration and development in Ivory Coast's Bloc CI-105 west of Abidjan.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan receives World Bank officials responsible for Ivory Coast; talks also deal with Ivory Coast's economic performance.
- Liberalisation of distribution of petrol in Ivory Coast, a recipe for anarchy.
- Privatisation of Ivorian phone monopoly CI-TELCOM: two percent of capital to be reserved for staff, says privatisation committee chief Lucas Danho.
